docs.title: EV Charging Stations - API Documentation
docs.text:
Base URL: "https://api.evcharging.mockapi.io/api/v1"

Resource: stations

This API manages EV charging station records and provides complete CRUD operations for charging stations.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text: This is a mock API created for demonstration purposes, so no authentication is required.

docs.title: Charging Station Object
docs.text: Field Type Description id string Unique identifier (auto-generated) stationName string Name of the charging station location string Station location status string Current station status connectorCount number Number of charging connectors createdAt string Record creation timestamp

docs.title: Endpoints Overview
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description GET /stations Fetch all charging stations GET /stations/{id} Fetch a single charging station POST /stations Create a new charging station PUT /stations/{id} Replace charging station data PATCH /stations/{id} Update charging station partially DELETE /stations/{id} Delete a charging station

docs.title: Testing the API
docs.text:
You can test all endpoints using:

  1. Postman
  2. Browser (for GET requests)

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
1. This API currently contains sample charging station records.
  2. IDs are automatically generated.
  3. Charging station status can be:
  4. Available
  5. Busy
  6. Offline
  7. Maintenance
  8. Since it is a mock API, data persistence may vary depending on the configuration.

docs.title: Conclusion
docs.text: This EV Charging Stations API provides complete CRUD functionality for managing charging station records. It allows users to create, view, update, and delete charging station information, making it suitable for EV charging network management applications.

docs.title: Get All Charging Stations
docs.text:
GET /stations

Description

Fetches a list of all charging stations.

docs.title: Get Single Charging Station
docs.text:
GET /stations/{id}

Description

Fetches a specific charging station by ID.

docs.title: Path Parameters
docs.text: Parameter Type Required Description id string Yes Charging station ID

docs.title: Update Charging Station (Partial Update)
docs.text:
PATCH /stations/{id}

Description

Updates specific fields of a charging station.

docs.title: Error Handling
docs.text: Status Code Description 400 Bad Request 404 Charging Station Not Found 500 Internal Server Error
